Something we've learned over the years is that a router provided to you by your internet service provider (ISP) is often:
﻿
* Mass produced by the lowest bidder 
* Made from the cheapest components available
* Made in a big hurry (to beat a deadline)
* May be updated with firmware that causes issues
* Fine for normal daily internet use (Web surfing, email, etc)
* Not suitable for PCVR streaming.
﻿
Not *every* ISP provided router but more often than not.
﻿
Adding your own router usually fixes any router related network issues. Type /routers to see a list of community tested routers.
